mcqs.question: Reed-Sternberg cells with classic 'owl-eye' binucleated appearance are diagnostic of:
mcqs.explanation: Reed-Sternberg cells (CD15+, CD30+) in a mixed inflammatory background are the hallmark neoplastic cells of Hodgkin lymphoma.
mcqs.subject: Pathology

mcqs.question: Which type of necrosis is classically observed in cerebral infarction (stroke) in brain tissue?
mcqs.explanation: Due to abundant lipid and hydrolytic lysosomal enzymes, hypoxic injury to the central nervous system manifests as liquefactive necrosis.
